violations.principle: Spec Compliance — OtelReceiver not wired into main.py
violations.issue: OtelReceiver is never imported, instantiated, or started. The OTLP/HTTP server never spins up. AC-06 and AC-07 cannot be satisfied in the running system — the entire observability pipeline is dead code.

violations.principle: Spec Compliance — No caller passes otel_port to dispatch()
violations.issue: dispatch() accepts otel_port and injects OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT when provided, but no code in main.py (or anywhere) calls dispatch(otel_port=...). The OTEL config setup and env var injection are unreachable.

runner.py:setup_logging() reads LOG_LEVEL but the ticket specifies BP_LOG_LEVEL. Also, OtelReceiver's log_level is never connected to any environment variable — no code reads BP_LOG_LEVEL and passes it to OtelReceiver(log_level=...). The receiver always defaults to 'info', making debug-level span emission impossible without modifying source.

violations.principle: Operational — Sandbox image missing OTEL SDK dependencies
violations.issue: Dockerfile.sandbox only installs opencode-ai via npm. @opentelemetry/sdk-node and related packages are absent. opencode's experimental.openTelemetry: true cannot emit OTEL spans without the SDK present in bun's environment. Identified as an open risk in the gap analysis but not addressed.

The second loop over attributes checking for key=="type" is dead code. The first loop (lines 125-132) already handles key in ("event.type", "type", "gen_ai.event.type"). The second loop can never return a value the first wouldn't return first.

violations.principle: Documentation — No README update for OTEL
violations.issue: README does not mention BP_LOG_LEVEL, the OTEL receiver, or that the sandbox image needs OTEL SDK npm packages. A human cannot follow the README to observe AC-06 or AC-07 behavior.

review_notes: OtelReceiver class and unit tests are well-structured — good deep module with small interface (start/stop) and thorough test coverage.
Test mocking is appropriate (system boundaries: sandbox, OpenCodeClient). Unit tests exercise OtelReceiver through real HTTP — integration-style testing at the unit level.
dispatch.py changes for OTEL env var injection and opencode.json config are correct in isolation but unreachable from the running system.
All 173 unit tests pass. Ruff lint passes with zero issues.
No integration tests exist for the OTEL pipeline end-to-end (receiver → log level filtering → stdout), but the issue's Testing Decisions section says 'None specific', so this is not a spec violation.
